translations.web: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
translations.kjv: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: But I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall take refuge in the name of Jehovah.
